tools.name: about
tools.description: What Trampoline Park Data (https://trampolineparkdata.com) measures at trampoline and adventure parks, its plans, free sample day and every document id, plus its sister sites.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ask a question in plain language. Returns the most relevant passages from Trampoline Park Data's public pages, each with its canonical URL to cite, plus its free sample day. Set site to all to search every Fron Research site.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one document by id (from search or about). sample/<site> returns that site's free example day as rows, CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: data
tools.description: Structured rows from the Fron Research Data API (https://api.fronresearch.com/v1): markets, venues, bookable slots and rollups of sell-through and modeled revenue. Without a key every query reads one free sample day for every venue, whatever dates are asked (the response's tier, free_day and range s

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "data" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: about, fetch · Public sink: data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: about, fetch · Public sink: data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
